arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Gershengorn argued the statute directly prohibits detrimental disclosures.
Mr. Katyal argued the law restrains agencies, not empowers them.
Justice Kennedy asked if statutes alone create disclosure prohibitions.
Justice Scalia stated the conduct is prohibited by regulations.
